The bird features dark brown plumage on its neck and body, with a pale yellow/cream-colored head and crown. Its most prominent feature is a long, massive bill with a visible gular pouch structure at the base, colored in dull orange/yellow tones. The eye is dark and distinct. The image focuses on the head and upper torso, cropping out the legs, feet, and full wing span.
